name: FLIR Lepton 3.5 Thermal Camera Module
notes: Primary recommended thermal core. Export-controlled; international orders require an End Use Statement. Wide-angle alternative: optional FLIR Lepton 3.1R (95 deg HFOV, 500-0758-03).

name: FLIR Lepton 3.1R Wide-Angle Thermal Module
value_spec: 160x120 LWIR, Radiometric, 95 deg HFOV (119 deg DFOV), Shutter
notes: Optional 95 deg wide-angle alternative to Lepton 3.5 (not in the required total). The enclosure clears its full 119 deg diagonal field of view.

name: FLIR Lepton 2.5 Thermal Camera Module
notes: Optional budget alternative to Lepton 3.5 (excluded from required total). FLIR EOL notice (last buy Sept 2027); prefer Lepton 3.5 or 3.1R.

name: FLIR Lepton Breakout Board V2.0
notes: Required carrier for Lepton 3.5/3.1R/2.5. Do not substitute PureThermal USB UVC boards (they lack the 2x10 SPI header).

name: Teensy 4.1 Development Board
value_spec: ARM Cortex-M7 600MHz, 8MB Flash, microSD, with pins
notes: Buy the version with pins (also at Adafruit, ID 4622). Leave its five inner pads empty: spring pins P3/P4 on the board touch VBAT and PROGRAM. If pins are soldered there, cut them flush underneath first; never force the Teensy down.

name: 3.2 Inch 240x320 TFT LCD Touch Display
value_spec: ILI9341 4-Wire SPI, 5V Supply, XPT2046 Resistive Touch
notes: Select exact options: Pin Header 4-Wire SPI, 5V Power Supply, 3.2-inch Resistive Touch Panel, No Font Chip. 2x20 2.54mm header pinout.

name: 32GB Class 10 / U1 microSDHC Card
notes: Any 16GB-32GB Class 10 / U1 microSDHC formatted FAT32 or exFAT works reliably with Teensy 4.1 SDIO.

name: DIY-Thermocam 2-Layer PCB
notes: Estimated per-board cost at qty 5 without assembly or shipping. Order files for JLCPCB, Seeed Fusion and PCBWay are in hardware/pcb/fab/.

name: DIY-Thermocam Enclosure
notes: Generated from hardware/enclosure/ (STEP, STL, 3MF, laser SVG/DXF).

name: M2.5 Standoffs, Nylon Washers and Screws
value_spec: 4x M2.5x20 F-F hex SW5 (005.02.205), 4x M2.5x11 M-F hex SW5 (005.12.119), 4x nylon washer 2.7/6.0 x 0.5 (003.03.026) on the rear standoffs, 4x M2.5x8 + 4x M2.5x14 ISO 7046 countersunk (001.12.238, 082.22.212)
notes: Per-camera share of Ettinger 100-packs (net, 1.10 USD/EUR). The washers keep the rear standoffs' hex corners off the SW2/SW3 pads. Laser case: use 4x M2.5x8 + 4x M2.5x14 ISO 7045 pan heads (001.17.232, 001.17.298) instead of the countersunk screws, each on a 003.03.026 washer. Brass 005.12.115 can replace the stainless 11 mm standoff (100-day lead time).

name: M2 Lepton Breakout Fasteners
notes: Per-camera share of Ettinger 100-packs (net, 1.10 USD/EUR). Screw heads sit on the display side of the main PCB on the nylon washers, which keep them off the D4/D26 tracks; the nuts go on the Lepton side.

name: 1/4-20 UNC Hex Nut (Tripod Mount)
value_spec: 1/4-20 UNC hex nut, 7/16 in AF x 5.5 mm, zinc-plated steel
notes: Same nut in both enclosures: captive in the shell's bottom boss, or in the printed tripod_mount of the laser case. Takes tripod screws up to 8 mm long.

name: 2x10 Right-Angle Female Header (Lepton Adapter)
value_spec: 2.54mm Pitch, Dual Row, Right Angle, Through-Hole
notes: Plugs onto the Lepton Breakout V2.0's right-angle 2x10 header; its legs go into J2. The breakout header sits 16 mm from J2, so it cannot plug in directly (same adapter as the V3 kit).

name: Slim Protected 3.7V 2000mAh 505060 LiPo Battery
notes: The battery cradle needs <=5.0mm nominal thickness (5.5mm max swell), UL/IEC 62133, built-in protection, JST-PH 2-pin. JST-PH polarity varies between sellers: check + against the J4 silkscreen before plugging in. Slim 1200mAh alternative: Adafruit ID 258.

name: USB-A to USB-C Data/Power Cable
notes: One USB-C cable for charging, USB streaming and Teensy firmware updates.

name: TI BQ24074 Li-Ion Power-Path Charger IC
value_spec: 1.5A Dynamic Power-Path Charger, 4.4V VSYS, ITERM Pin
notes: USB-C charger with power path: runs the camera from USB and charges the battery at the same time. R11=1.2k (1.3A input limit), R10=1.0k (890mA charge), R23=3.0k (90mA termination), R14=47k (~6.3h timer).

name: TI TPS61022 Synchronous 5V Boost Converter
value_spec: 8A Switch, 5.10V Out (R16=750k / R17=100k), True Load Disconnect
notes: 5.1V boost for Teensy, display and Lepton. SW1 drives its EN pin; in shutdown the output is fully disconnected, so the battery still charges while the camera is off.

name: XC6206P332MR-G 3.3V Low-Quiescent RTC LDO
notes: Powers Teensy 4.1 VBAT (VDD_SNVS_IN 2.4-3.6V) from the battery at ~1uA, so the clock keeps time without a coin cell. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.0uH 15A Shielded Power Inductor
notes: Power inductor for the TPS61022 boost converter (U2).

name: 2A Resettable PTC Polyfuse (1206)
notes: Battery overcurrent protection after the Q1/Q2 reverse-polarity circuit.

name: USB 2.0 ESD Protection Diode Array
notes: Protects Teensy USB D+/D- differential pair at board-edge USB-C receptacle J3.

name: Red 0603 SMD Charging Status LED
notes: Driven by BQ24074 open-drain ~CHG pin (lit while charging). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: AO3401A P-Channel MOSFET (Reverse-Polarity)
notes: Primary active reverse-polarity LiPo protection MOSFET on J4. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: AO3400A N-Channel MOSFET (Gate Interlock)
notes: Gate interlock keeping Q1 hard-OFF into a reversed LiPo even when USB-C is plugged in (<10uA quiescent). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: USB Type-C 16-Pin SMD Receptacle
notes: Board-edge USB-C port feeding BQ24074 IN and Teensy 4.1 D+/D- pogo pins P1/P2.

name: JST-PH 2.0mm 2-Pin SMD Battery Header
notes: Standard Adafruit/SparkFun LiPo polarity (always verify +/- silkscreen before connecting). Protected by Q1/Q2 + F1.

name: 2x20 (40-Pin) Female Display Socket
notes: Top-side socket for the BuyDisplay ER-TFTM032-3. The only part on the top side (through-hole).

name: 2x10 (20-Pin) Female Lepton Socket
value_spec: 2.54mm Pitch, Dual Row, Straight, Through-Hole, 8.5mm Height
notes: Bottom-side socket for the FLIR Lepton Breakout Board V2.0, which plugs in through the right-angle adapter (conn-lepton-adapter-ra). Plain socket, 25.8 x 5.0 mm body; do not substitute a wider box-header socket.

name: 1x24 (24-Pin) Female Teensy Socket
notes: Bottom-side sockets for a pre-pinned Teensy 4.1. 8.5mm socket + 2.5mm header plastic = 11mm, the pogo pins' working height.

name: SMD Spring Pogo Pin (12.0mm Free / 11.0mm Working)
notes: Spring contacts under the Teensy 4.1, so nothing is soldered to it. P1/P2 press on the USB D+/D- pads and carry USB data from the USB-C port. P3 (VBAT, clock supply) and P4 (PROGRAM, pinhole button) sit 0.5 mm off the centre of the 0.965 mm inner holes so the domed 0.9 mm tip rests on the hole's copper ring.

name: Right-Angle SMD Slide Power Switch
notes: Board-edge power switch on the TPS61022 EN pin (the battery keeps charging while off). Operated through the enclosure's slide_switch_cap.

name: Right-Angle SMD Tactile Capture Switch
notes: Board-edge capture button on Teensy pin 2. Operated through the enclosure's capture_button.

name: SMD Tactile PROG Switch
notes: Pressed through a pinhole in the back shell to start the Teensy bootloader. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 10uF 25V X5R 0805 MLCC Capacitor
notes: BQ24074 IN/OUT/BAT and rail decoupling capacitors. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 100nF 50V X7R 0603 MLCC Capacitor
notes: High-frequency bypass for the power, ESD and RTC LDO rails, and the battery ADC input filter (C12). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 22uF 25V X5R 0805 MLCC Capacitor
notes: TPS61022 input/output capacitors next to U2. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 47k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 ~6.3h safety timer (R14) and reverse-polarity gate bias (R20). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 470k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Battery ADC divider upper leg (R1, with R2 = 1M): same 0.68 ratio as before, about 2.5 uA battery drain. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1M Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Battery ADC divider lower leg (R2, filtered by C12). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.0k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 R_ISET (R10, ~890mA charge current) and ~CHG LED current limiter (R12). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.2k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 R_ILIM (1.3A USB input current limit, >= TI 1.1k minimum). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 100k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: VBUS ADC divider (R3, R5), TPS61022 EN pull-down (R15), FB lower leg (R17), and R24 across Q1 so a fully drained pack can be recharged. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 750k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: TPS61022 5.10V FB upper leg (R16) and ultra-low-drain Q1/Q2 gate interlock pull resistors (R18, R21).

name: 10k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 TS pull-down (R9), LCD backlight pull-up (R19), and BQ24074 EN2 pull-up to regulated VSYS (R22). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 3.0k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24074 ITERM termination programming resistor (~90mA / 10.1% charge termination). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 4.7k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: I2C SDA0/SCL0 pull-up resistors for FLIR Lepton CCI (R4, R6). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 5.1k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Mandatory USB-C CC1 and CC2 sink pull-downs to request 5V from USB-C PD chargers. JLCPCB Basic part.
